schema_version: v0 — skill-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: Open the design work on a born intention: name the berth being worked, where the work is arriving from, what has to be resolved before it can be cast, and what would make it castable.
why: The workflow's third step (press_office/WorkflowDefinition.md, `design`) and the only one with a DIFFERENT SKILL AT EACH END — /design opens the joint work, /sorted closes it. Everything between /intent and /sorted happens in conversation today, and conversation leaves no artifact: a berth is born, some amount of thinking happens, and a cast ticket appears with no record of what was worked or how many passes it took. The lived symptom is the second one — a node routed back from /sorted for completeness re-enters design and nothing anywhere records that it is a second pass, so the question 'which of /intent's questions are failing to catch things' has no denominator. This door is where that arrival becomes data.
invoke: /design [intention]  (a berth exists and is not yet cast)
state: v0 — first cast 2026-08-04, building out the workflow's two missing end doors. The middle of the workflow was built first; both missing doors were at the ends, which is exactly where a person and the system work together.
produces: a berth under ~/.cairn/devices/skill_block/0/berths/design/ recording that a design session opened on a named intention, with its work list and its own completion predicate. No commons artifact: the artifact of the design STEP is the cast ticket, and /sorted writes that.

nexus.note: SKILL.md carries the live sequence; this is the charter-face record of it.
nexus.routes_forward: /sorted — the resolution pivot, which casts the node and binds its gates
nexus.routes_back: /sorted routes back HERE on a completeness red; that return is an entry, recorded in `entering_from`, not a failure with no address

input_contract.intent_berth: the /intent berth this design works on — a readable berth path for skill `intent` whose exit was `routed_forward`. The two refusals this earns are the point: a berth that does not resolve is a design session on nothing, and a berth that was routed OUT is a design session on a node the trace question already killed. The one other legal value is 'none, because <X>' with a JUDGEABLE reason — one carrying a resolvable referent (a path, a cast ticket id, a roster command), following the same rule buildme_rides_the_sorted already enforces. Silence is not on the menu.
input_contract.entering_from: how this design session is being entered: `intent` for a first pass, or `sorted:<berth path>` for a node routed back from the resolution pivot on a completeness red. The sorted berth must resolve. Forced because this is the back-edge /intent's charter names as ABSENT — 'nothing yet connects a LATER gate's rejection to the /intent firing that let it through' — and one recorded field is what turns that from prose into a countable arrival.
input_contract.open_questions: the list of what must be RESOLVED before this can be cast — the design step's actual work list. A list, not a paragraph: one blob is one question wearing a plural, and the point of the field is that each item can be answered and struck. Forced because a design session with no named questions is a conversation, and a conversation is the thing this step keeps losing.
input_contract.ready_when: the predicate that ENDS this step — what would make this node castable. Distinct from the intention's falsifier, which asks whether the WORK is done or was wrongly aimed; this asks whether the THINKING is finished enough to bind gates to. Written here so /sorted has something to check the cast against rather than re-deriving readiness from scratch (Law 1).
input_contract.bullets: the exit-time finding — a list of {text, stratum} with stratum in code|tree, standing at Akien's gate. At an OPENING that is what reading the berth and the congruency lab surfaced: a prior-art hit, a collision, a question the birth did not ask. A design session that opens having noticed nothing usually has not read anything.
input_contract.intentions_cleared: what intentions were checked against the congruency lab before exit — a list of intention names or paths that were reviewed, or 'none checked' if the session opened and closed without a congruency sweep. Forced because a design pass that does not check the lab re-derives what /intent's model consult already answered (Law 1), and a return trip that skips it doubles the cost.
input_contract.tickets_reviewed: what tickets were reviewed to understand the neighbourhood before exit — a list of ticket ids that were read, or 'none reviewed' if the session proceeded without reviewing neighbours. Forced because a design pass on a node whose neighbours are not read is a design pass that discovers collisions at /sorted instead of here, which is how the return trip happens.

not_in_the_contract.what_changed: the design work's substance is not captured here. /sorted's twelve fields are where the resolved thinking has to stand up, and restating it at the opening would be asking for the answers before the questions have been worked.

how_it_learns: By the ratio this door's own records make countable: how many design sessions on a given berth. A first pass is `entering_from: intent`; every subsequent one is `entering_from: sorted:<berth>`, so the count of return trips per node is readable by walking the design berths — which is the denominator /intent's `how_it_learns` names as missing. The reader now exists: probes/design_return_trip.py, the watch the boat carries (WATCHME(design-return-trip), ticket the-return-trip-is-countable, armed 2026-08-07). It walks that field every pulse — denominator distinct nodes by intent_berth, not firings — reads /sorted's promised back-to-design dispositions beside it so a zero arrives as a measured fork instead of a guess, fires when >= 12 distinct nodes show zero recorded returns, and clears on the first witnessed arrival (an existence claim: none has ever been recorded). The CONSUMER of the count — the dial over which of /intent's questions are letting things through — is still a separate node, named as absent rather than implied; building it before any node has been through twice would be building a manager for an empty room.
traces_to: Law 1 (the resolver spent on the novel — a design pass re-derived is the defect)
Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — the return-trip count is the measurement)
Law 5 (intent, its voyage and its proofs share an address)
owner: the skills charter gates writes to this file; Akien ratifies changes (signature gate)
proof: proofs/test_design_door.py — the door refuses a berth that does not resolve, a berth that was routed out, a wrong-skill berth, a hollow exemption, a malformed entering_from, and a paragraph where a list belongs; a conforming packet berths and pollutes neither the live trace nor the live commons. The class gate (cairnmap recompiles green) remains an IOU until cairnmap is built.
provenance: Akien's fill of the workflow catalog's empty cells, 2026-08-04: '/design [intention]'. The each-end-a-different-skill shape is already recorded in press_office/WorkflowDefinition.md §3, and /sorted's charter already names 'completeness red → design' as its route back — this door is the address that route was pointing at.
learns: It does not; it is a design tool — it assists design without learning from outcomes.
